description: Module 13 — Swagger annotations, custom health endpoint, all documentation files, Postman collection, .env.example, final PROJECT_PROGRESS.md and SESSION_HANDOFF.md, then full build+test verification
steps: Add @Tag, @Operation, @ApiResponse, @Parameter annotations to all controllers: PartnerController, InsurerController, PartnerInsurerMappingController, ApiClientAdminController, AuthController, IngestionController, AdminIngestionController. Every public endpoint must have @Operation(summary=..., description=...) and @io.swagger.v3.oas.annotations.responses.ApiResponse entries for 200/201/400/401/403/404/422/500 as applicable

Create src/main/java/com/insurance/integration/config/AdminHealthController.java — @RestController @RequestMapping('/api/v1/admin/health'). GET /: check DB connection (run a simple JDBC query via DataSource) + check SQS reachability (call SqsClient.getQueueUrl for the configured queue, catch and return degraded). Returns { status, db, sqs, timestamp }. Add to SecurityConfig PUBLIC_PATHS or require auth (choose require auth for admin health)
Create docs/01-Project-Overview.md — 2-3 pages describing the system, its purpose, partners, insurers, key capabilities, technology stack
Create docs/05-Module-Architecture.md — describes each of the 14 modules, their responsibilities, interfaces and dependencies
Create docs/07-ER-Diagram.md — ASCII or Mermaid ER diagram of all 15 database tables with relationships
Create docs/08-API-Documentation.md — document all REST endpoints with method, path, auth requirements, request/response examples, error codes
Create docs/09-Partner-Integration-Guide.md — step-by-step guide for a partner: get credentials, get token, submit request, check status, interpret errors
Create docs/10-AWS-Architecture.md — describes S3 source/destination, SQS, SNS, Lambda worker, IAM roles, cross-account access
Create docs/11-S3-Document-Transfer-Workflow.md — sequence diagram of the full document transfer flow from pre-signed URL to insurer bucket
Create docs/12-Validation-Engine.md — describes schema validation, field rules, document rules, ValidationResult structure
Create docs/13-Asynchronous-Processing.md — describes outbox pattern, SQS integration, TransferJob lifecycle, retry/DLQ
Create docs/14-Security-Architecture.md — describes OAuth 2.0 client credentials, JWT, SSRF protection, HMAC webhooks, IAM least-privilege
Create docs/15-Error-Handling.md — all error codes, GlobalExceptionHandler, error response format
Create docs/16-Testing-Strategy.md — unit test approach (Mockito), integration test approach (Testcontainers), test coverage goals
Create docs/17-Test-Execution-Report.md — honest report of which tests were written and what they cover (do NOT fabricate results)
Create docs/18-Deployment-Guide.md — how to build JAR, configure environment variables, run locally, deploy to EC2/ECS
Create docs/19-Environment-Configuration.md — all environment variables with descriptions, defaults, required vs optional
Create docs/20-Troubleshooting.md — common issues: DB connection fails, Flyway migration errors, JWT invalid, SQS not reachable, SSRF blocked
Create docs/21-Final-Project-Report.md — honest account of what is implemented, what works, what is a stub/mock, known limitations

Create postman/Insurance-Integration-Middleware.postman_collection.json — Postman collection JSON with folders: Auth (POST /token), Partner Management (admin CRUD), Ingestion (submit + status), Admin (list, get, retry). Include example request bodies and expected responses. Use {{baseUrl}} variable. The collection must be valid Postman v2.1 collection format
Ensure .env.example exists at project root with all variables from application.yml
Create infrastructure/lambda/README.md — describes the Lambda worker contract: event format (from SQS message), expected behavior, IAM permissions needed, deployment instructions
Update PROJECT_PROGRESS.md — mark all modules complete with checkmarks
Update SESSION_HANDOFF.md — final state describing complete implementation
Update README.md — add quick-start section, link to docs/, list all endpoints
Run: mvn clean package -DskipTests — must succeed
Run: mvn test — run all tests and fix any failures. Report final test count
Run: git add -A && git commit -m 'feat: complete Insurance Integration Middleware - all modules implemented'
acceptance_criteria: postman collection is valid JSON with at minimum 8 request examples
verification: Run: mvn clean package -DskipTests — BUILD SUCCESS
Run: mvn test — all tests pass
Count docs/: ls docs/ | wc -l — should be at least 18 files
Validate postman collection: python -m json.tool postman/Insurance-Integration-Middleware.postman_collection.json (or equivalent JSON validation)
